events.subtitle: Classic trio at Kichijoji's audio-focused Otokichi! MEG
events.factual_description: Otokichi! MEG's official event page lists Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio on Thursday, October 8, 2026, from 19:30 to 21:30, with Tsuyoshi Yamamoto on piano, Hiroshi Kagawa on bass, and Toshio Osumi on drums. The same primary page lists a ¥4,000 ticket and states that the price is plus a ¥500 table charge, two orders, and consumption tax. The venue's official map identifies the location as 1-31-3 Kichijoji Honcho, Musashino, Tokyo.

enrichment.note: The exact official Otokichi! MEG event page verifies the date, 19:30-21:30 event time, complete trio lineup, ¥4,000 ticket, additional table-charge/order/tax terms, and contains the venue's booking form. The official venue map verifies the Musashino/Kichijoji location, and an exact Apple Music album destination for Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio is verified.

sources.note: Primary event and booking page confirms October 8, 2026; 19:30-21:30; Tsuyoshi Yamamoto on piano, Hiroshi Kagawa on bass, Toshio Osumi on drums; ¥4,000 ticket; plus ¥500 table charge, two orders, and tax; and the on-page reservation form.
Primary venue site describes the Kichijoji jazz cafe/live house and its stated focus on carefully built analog, CD, and high-resolution sound, alongside evening jazz performances.
Primary venue map confirms Otokichi! MEG at 1-31-3 Kichijoji Honcho, Musashino, Tokyo and lists regular Wednesday-Friday live hours of 19:30-21:30.
Exact Apple Music album page for Blues For K by Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio.

MEG's exact event and venue pages; the listening destination was verified on Apple Music. Repository searches for the proposed stable event ID, October 8 Yamamoto date, Otokichi! MEG, and 音吉 found no existing canonical, curated, or processed match before publication. Priority was assigned only after Stage 1 RADAR admission; the recurring classic-trio context was used explicitly to keep the event below the scarcity tiers.

en.why_it_matters: The setting is the hook: Yamamoto's long-running Kagawa/Osumi trio lands in a Kichijoji room that defines itself around careful analog, CD, and high-resolution playback as well as live jazz. For a pianist whose records sit at the heart of Japanese audiophile jazz listening, that sound-obsessed small-room context makes this more than another trio date—the familiar chemistry gets heard in a venue built around listening itself.
en.trip_verdict: If Greater Tokyo is in play on October 8, make room for Kichijoji and build the evening around the trio. The same core appears elsewhere, so this is a strong Tokyo night rather than a reason to restructure an entire Japan itinerary.
en.listen_before: Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio — Blues For K

es.why_it_matters: La sala es el gancho: el trío de larga trayectoria de Yamamoto con Kagawa y Osumi llega a un cuarto de Kichijoji que se define tanto por el jazz en vivo como por cuidar el sonido analógico, CD y de alta resolución. Para un pianista cuyos discos están en el centro de la escucha audiófila del jazz japonés, ese contexto íntimo y obsesionado con el sonido vuelve la fecha algo más que otra aparición del trío: la química conocida se escucha en un lugar construido alrededor del acto de escuchar.
es.trip_verdict: Si Greater Tokyo está en juego el 8 de octubre, haría espacio para Kichijoji y armaría la noche alrededor del trío. El mismo núcleo aparece en otros lugares, así que es una noche fuerte de Tokio, no una razón para reorganizar por completo un viaje a Japón.
